nom: Exuviance Lift Volumizing Hyaluronic Acid Face Concentrate

avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The pump is easy to use. I like that it can be closed for traveling to eliminate spillage. It lefty face feeling moisturized. It was a perfect consistency for layering. The one thing I did not like was the smell.

The packaging is absolutely beautiful. Very sleek. The product itself is great. The first couple times I used it i did feel a burning sensation but the more I used it the less I felt. It really helped with some of my fine lines on my forehead and near my eyes.

I'm someone who has tried a lotttt of products. Oily skin, early 20's, type IV on the Fitzpatrick scale. This keeps my skin taut and plump. I definitely noticed a difference after using it. "Natural Filler" is a pretty darn accurate way to explain this products effect. And the amount you get/usage over time lasts for a while, for me, I got it three-four months ago and still have over 3/4 of the bottle left. I will definitely be buying and trying more Exuviance products!

I recieved a sample sized tube in my Ulta favorites and was pleasantly surprised by the glowing finish it left on my skin. It also has a gentle tightening effect which minimized my crows feet. I highly recommend this for aging skin.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Loved this hydrating formula and it helped with adding a more youthful look to my skin!!!! I could tell it helped reduce the appearance of smile lines. Must try.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Oops- so the bottle would not prime to push through the button and requires you to prime upside down to push the product out. Once the product is out of the bottle: There is a shine upon putting on but has a funky play dough type scent and a little bit sticky on hands.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The Exuviance Lift Volumizing Concentrate is a great addition to my skincare routine. I like to use it on my neck and under my chin for the anti aging benefits. My skin is sensitive and I don't use under my eyes because that's my most sensitive area and prone to eczema, but it feels great on the rest of my face.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] One of my new favorite skincare products! I was amazed how it tightened my skin with no uncomfortable feel. The scent was nice and pilling was fun to see. Definitely helped my redness!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have used this every morning and night since receiving it and I believe it is working. It feels very nice on my skin and doesn't irritate nor breakout my skin. It also absorbs immediately, no drying time. See my photos, you be the judge

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I don't like this. It smells weird and has weird consistency: I won't be using it. I don't really see the effect on this either. The product also gets stuck coming out and then when you squirt it out, it wastes product

It absorbs immediately and I love the way it feels on my skin but until I took my photo today, I couldn't see a difference. I will use it until the end and hopefully I can see the more of a difference. One photo is from 11/4/25 and the other from 12/31/25. You be the judge.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Loved this product! It's very lightweight and absorbed well into my skin. I have sensitive acne prone skin and Im glad this didn't make me break out! It's gentle yet effective. I noticed some lines fade away. I also love the packaging. It's nice and an easy to use bottle.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Overall I like the results, even though it has a few quirks. The pump is kind of weird and not very smooth, and honestly the smell isn't great. That said, the formula itself is very lightweight, absorbs easily, and doesn't feel heavy on the skin. With regular use, it really helps smooth my skin, plumps it up, and makes fine lines look softer, which makes it worth using despite the downsides.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Very hydrating and plumping. Sits well under my moisturizer at night and makes my skin noticeably more radiant the next day. It makes my neck feel less crepey. I have sensitive skin and it didn't irritate it or interfere with my retinol.

avis.titre: A lightweight, gentle serum that offers subtle plumping and
avis.texte: This volumizing concentrate has a lightweight texture that absorbs quickly and layers well with other skincare products. It provides good hydration and a subtle plumping effect that helps skin look smoother and more refreshed over time. The formula is gentle, with minimal scent, and is unlikely to cause redness or irritation for most users. While the lifting effect is not dramatic, it performs well as part of a consistent routine and delivers gradual, noticeable improvement.

Haven't been using it for very long but I do feel like it hydrates my skin and leaves it feeling more plump I'll continue to use it to see how it works in the wrinkle department! Pleased with it so far overall

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love that the product is hydrating, easy to apply, and doesn't come with any excessive fragrance! The packaging is very nice but takes time to plump the product out. Doesn't irritates my skin nor does it give me breakout, and it has a nice lotion like texture.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was very impressed with this filler. I applied it every morning as part of my make-up routine and found it easy to apply my make-up over. It was very lightweight, absorbed well, and didn't cause my skin to feel oily. After about a month of use, I did see an improvement in the fine lines around my smile line area.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Has been a nice product so far. I've been using it for about a month. My only problem was my bottle didn't come with the straw inside for the pump. The smell isn't the best, but it does go on smooth and doesn't feel greasy. It seems great for all skin types. Leaves my skin feeling healthy and I can tell it's staying on.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This Exuviance Lift Volumizing Ckncentrate is really at home filler. It helps get rid of unwanted lines and it's very easy to use. It also leaves your skin very hydrated. I definitely will keep using this.
One of the best things that I have used for my face light weight and leaves my face feeling rejuvenated

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have squeezed this into my already simple skin care regime, and I have to say I absolutely love it. I've noticed the surface of my skin has gotten a little more even a little more smooth and fine lines are less visible my face overall. It's gentle enough to use every day. Highly recommend.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product goes on nice, smooth and hydrating. It doesn't have a smell, which is nice. I haven't really noticed any difference it has made with wrinkles or fullness.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was really disappointed with the Exuviance Lift Volumizing Concentrate. The smell is unpleasant and lingers after application, which made it hard to use consistently. Unfortunately, I also didn't notice any lifting, plumping, or volumizing effects at all, even after giving it plenty of time.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I didn't notice a plumping or lifting effect but I definitely enjoy using this product. It makes my skin feel moisturized without being sticky. Would buy again if it was on sale probably wouldn't purchase at full price.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This worked pretty well while I used it to keep my skin healthy, moisturized and as wrinkle free as I can get for someone in her mid-30s. Didn't have an odor and wasn't too rough to apply!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Does not seem like they have good quality control. Opened it for the first time and could not get the pump to work. Opened it up and there was no tube. No way for the product to come out of the pump. The product smells good but when I get about half way I am going to have to stick something in it to get product out. Other than that MAIN issue I have not had any breakouts.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This serum is incredible! It delivers instant hydration and leaves my skin feeling unbelievably soft and looking visibly fuller, with smile lines appearing smoother after only a few applications. The texture is divine—lightweight, non-greasy, and fast absorbs, creating a smooth, gel-like base perfect for makeup. The scent isn't my favorite. But the bottle and packaging is nice with its easy-to-use pump makes applying it al, fuss-free experience.

I received this product for free to try in exchange for my honest review. Unfortunately this product broke me out. I have very sensitive skin and tend to get a rash from certain products. This product doesn't have a pleasant smell. It's almost too overwhelming.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is my first time using brand Exuviance but love it so much, that I decided to keep it as my stable skincare product. I have used it both in morning and at night then notice the benefits immediately, my skin is so lifted and young, without any minor irritation, plus it is totally moisturized and well hydrated. Plus the package is great design so the cream can be pumped out easily.

avis.titre: Keeps your skin hydrated over the night
avis.texte: I have been trying for over a month this serum and I feel like it helps me to smooth my fine lines around my cheek bones. The texture is very light and absorbs fast, after applied it I noticed a beautiful glow. I have very sensitive skin and while I was using it didn't cause any irritation or breaks out. Last but not least, I think the hyaluronic acid helps me to retain the hydration during the night. The only con I found it was that I'm not very fond of the scent but it didn't bother me too much since is very subtle. Definitely I'm going to switch my usual night serum routine with this one
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was skeptical at first but oh man I saw such an improvement in fine lines, my skin looked smoother and clearer. Really wonderful.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am so excited that I can finally try the exuviance skin care line. This was the missing link to my skin care routine. It can be layered under moisturizer as well, which that's what I do in the evening. It has made my skin very plumped. So excited to see more results within the end of the month.

avis.titre: Save the money- not worth it
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was excited to try the Exuviance Lift Volumizing Concentrate. It claims to give results like a "filler." The initial smell is a little off putting and not my favorite. It dispenses easily, goes on a little sticky and reveals almost a peeling residue if you rub the area after applying. After using I found this product did nothing for my face as claimed. I appreciate that I had no irritation or breakouts. I also didn't have any "filling" either.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I haven't noticed any changes yet but I will continue to use. Took one star away the the smell. It's not the greatest. It goes on smooth and clean though. My skin is super dry so it's helping a little with that.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] After using this Exuviance Lift Volumizing Concentrate twice a day for 25 days, the only noticeable results are more moisturized and softer skin. No noticeable lifting or firming of lines such as the visible smile lines. My face is very soft to touch, almost silky like. The use for twice a day seems excessive and I wouldn't normally want to put that much time into skin care routine for little to no results. The scent isn't horrible, but it is odd. I imagine walking into a donut shop that only makes cake donuts. Again, not horrible, but it is weird on my face.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This lift concentrate is an amazing product. Has a smooth texture that is lightweight, absorbs quickly, and is non sticky. Provides noticeable hydration and brighter skin. Also, love that my skin skin looks smoother and firmer. Great high quality item with impressive results.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like the consistency of the product. The lid is a little wonky sometimes but has good amount of product. It put back some firmness into my skin and has a nice glow.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was very excited to receive this free product for review. I love the packaging is very easy to use. As for the product I found it very drying and it caused me an allergic reaction. After applying it several times I found it burned, I had to stop using it. I wish it worked for me but due to my allergic reaction I won't be able to tell if it works.
My first time trying. I like the smoothness of the concentrate & how in makes my skin feel plump, but I'm not huge on the smell.

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I've been using this for around 3 weeks and have noticed a very slight difference in my skin, more so feeling very hydrated rather than actual lifting. My skin does feel more firm, as is expected with a deeply hydrating lotion/serum. The concentrate absorbs well and doesn't leave my skin feeling tacky. Overtime i do expect to see more results, but within 3 weeks of use not much will be seen with any firming skincare products.

avis.titre: A gentle but effective serum that delivers results
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This serum absorbs quickly and gives my skin a noticeable boost in firmness and volume, especially around my cheeks and jawline. It feels lightweight, plays well with the rest of my routine, and hasn't caused any irritation. After a couple of weeks, my skin looks smoother and more lifted. Highly recommend!

I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. Unfortunately after the first application I got a rash from the product. I have sensitive skin and was afraid this might happen. I will say I didn't care for the scent either.

avis.titre: Must have for your skincare routine!
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this product. It makes my skin feel so fresh and youthful. The texture is great and melts into my skin! The scent isn't overbearing and I love that.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This packaging looks super nice! Very sleek and high end with that gray bottle. I love a good pump dispenser too! The product itself is that clear, light pink gel texture, and it looks like it would glide right on. It seems like it would feel really light and hydrating. It's definitely not sticky or heavy, which is exactly what you want in a concentrate.

This product works very well and I am pleased with it. It's light weight to put on, and it immediately helped with my dryness. Not sure how it does with breakouts or redness, but it feels like it tightens my skin under my eyes which is a plus. Definitely would recommend to family and friends to purchase if your looking for a lightweight wrinkle cream.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really enjoyed this serum. It really does a great job of helping to keep my skin plump and hydrated during the cold winter months. I follow up with a moisturizer after using this product! :)

avis.titre: It's okay for what it is
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I like how lightweight this is. I have an easy time incorporating it into my routine. No irritation and the package is easy to use. I wish it was more hydrating, but it is good.

This concentrate is gentle and absorbs well, and I appreciate the hyaluronic acid in the formula. My skin did become a little clearer, which was a nice bonus. However, I didn't really see the volumizing or line-softening results it claims to deliver. It's decent overall, but I didn't get the noticeable improvement I was hoping for.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product has a pump top function and I absolutely love that feature. However, that is probably the only positive thing I can say about this product. It smells awful. Leaves my face greasy. I did not notice any changes with my skin.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have used this prompts for a few weeks now and been starting to see its effect. The formula is light and not too thick. I apply it to areas that need lifting and it's been feeling really great. I see improvement and preservation. For my own purposes I like to apply it every other night.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Love the fact that the texture is a slight creamy and feel with decent slip. The smell is neutral which I do like with my skin care. It paired very nicely with the rest of my skin care routine. Having sensitive skin I had no negative reaction! That is a huge plus! With all skin care products you need to be consistent and consistency does pay off!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Love the fact that the texture is a slight creamy and feel with decent slip. The smell is neutral which I do like with my skin care. It paired very nicely with the rest of my skin care routine. Having sensitive skin I had no negative reaction! That is a huge plus! With all skin care products you need to be consistent and consistency does pay off!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Soaks into skin and is very moisturizing. I wear it at night and I also wear it during the day under my makeup and it keeps my skin feeling hydrated all day and night long.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Do you see this skin? The texture is smooth but not cracked and dry? No breakouts or blemishes? I cannot believe the difference this concentrate has made on my combination skin! It's not irritating at all but makes my skin look so plump and smooth! Will have to get again!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Exuviance Lift Volumizing Concentrate works great! It absorbs into my skin quickly making it feel soft and not sticky or oily. After 6 weeks of use, I noticed a difference in the lines by my mouth. I wasn't aware of how well it decreased my smile lines until I looked back at pictures from before starting it. I would recommend this product!

Obsessed with this. It legit made my skin look more lifted and plump in just a couple weeks. The texture is super silky, absorbs fast, and gives that "smooth, bouncy skin" vibe. If you want a quick glow-up firming, this one is so worth it.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have been using the Exuviance Lift Volumizing Concentrate for about a month now and my skin looks brighter, more hydrated, and my fine lines look a little smoother! (I compared some before and after photos before writing a review). The formula is lightweight and absorbs quickly, and sits well under other products. I've noticed my skin doesn't feel tight and dehydrated anymore. Definitely a keeper for my skincare routine.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am a sucker for simple packaging. I think it's sleek and the fact the lid locks is AWESOME! I didn't smell any sort of scent which I like in my face skin care. The product itself is kind of a weird yellowish white. It doesn't feel sticky or tacky. A little goes a long way. I will say this left my face feeling hydrated but I didn't notice any lift or firming. I definitely plan to keep it in my skin care routine to see if anything changes.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I haven't used it long enough to see results but I like the pump on this product. I also like how smooth it goes on, it pretty much melts into your skin.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The packaging for this product is great, I love it. I love the airless pump and the big, flat pump on top of the bottle. It also seems to come with a good amount of product. I really want to love it, I just haven't really noticed any results yet. It also has a weird smell, almost similar to playdoh. I'm still using it hoping that I'll eventually see some results. The product itself is smooth and feels really nice to apply. It does pill up under my makeup, so I tend to use it at night and whenever I'm planning to go makeup-free.

avis.titre: My face looks plunder and more radiant
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The Exuviance Lift Volumizing Concentrate! It's really helped smooth out my skin and reduce the appearance of my smile lines. My face looks plunder and more radiant. The Hyaluronic Acid and Neo Glucoamine work wonders in softening those pesky expression lines. My only gripe is the packaging - the pump tube was missing, so I have to dig in with my finger, which isn't ideal for hygiene or convenience. Hopefully, that's just a one-off issue! Overall, I'd recommend this product to anyone looking to boost their skin's hydration and firmness.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Exuviance Lift Volumizing concentrate is a great addition to my skincare routine. It's a lightweight almost gel like consistency that goes on super smooth leaving my skin feeling so soft! The smell is not strong and dissipates quickly. The overall texture and appearance of my skin has improved!

Not sure if I just got a defective one, but the pump on the bottle I received does not work. I have to unscrew the top and use a stick to get any product out. That alone would make me not want to buy this in the future. The product itself feels really nice and doesn't have a strong scent to it. I've used it with facial tools and it glides nicely. Doesn't leave a greasy feel. I can't tell if it works, but it doesn't not work, you know?

avis.titre: Luxurious Skincare Line Showing Visible Results
avis.texte: Beautiful line of skincare! The pump Bottle gives plenty of serum (about 3 months worth), and the pump dispenses just the right amount. It is velvety smooth, and goes on weightless and even. After about a week, saw visible results, and now after a month, my skin texture has improved and fine lines are diminishing.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was worried this product was going to sting or feel tight on my skin but it's pretty comfortable. I haven't noticed any irritation but I am liking the results so far!

I have been using this Exuviance lift volumizing concentrate daily for almost a month now and I am loving the results. I apply this to my clean skin and it feels nice, it is not heavy, it absorbs into my skin well without leaving a film or anything behind. My skin looks clear, bright and smooth! I love the bottle and keep it on my sink so I never forget to use it morning or night. A little goes a long way so this bottle will last a long time!

avis.titre: Actually does what it claims to!
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product actually seemed to plump up my skin. I felt like it lifted my forehead wrinkles and helped my skin have more volume. The smell is potent but doesn't last. For the price, they need to work on a better pump. It felt very cheap and dug into my fingertips when dispensing product.

The pump don't work so I had to waste a lot of product to get it out. The product smells like a box of crayons. I couldn't help that it helped with fine lines but it did give my skin the shiny look and didn't dry out.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like using this Lift Volumizing Concentrate from Exuviance. I like that the application is easy and it's been helping with some hydration and volume. I would recommend this product to friends.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product contains triple hyaluronic acid and NeoGlucosamine and claims your skin can appear plump and youthful. I am at the age where I'm starting to notice fine lines creep up and had high hopes for this product. First the packaging, took me a week to figure out that you have to tip the bottle upside down for it to dispense properly through the pump. At first I was unscrewing the cap and scooping the product out with my fingers. Maybe the packaging I received was faulty, but for this price, I was already unamused. I expect a precise disbursement and probably used more than I should have. The product states its fragrance free but there is a slight plastic scent that dissipates after applying. The texture is like a cream gel. I thought I would look a little glowy or have a slight glass like appearance after applying but my skin appeared looking the same before applying. It will take time before I notice a difference but I probably will not repurchase if it still being sold in the same packaging. I used the product as suggested, under my moisturizer 2x a day. Did not experience any irritation or breakouts. Please use sunscreen when using this product.

I received this product free in exchange for my honest review. Wonderful products in a awesome design bottle. That feels great on my skin.I was surprised how fast it is , sorbs into my skin and how wonderful it made my skin look , it moisturized to made me look up years younger , especially around my eyes , which that self is a amazing thing

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was very excited to give this product a try. Overall I love it. It does what it claims to do. It acts as a filler and fills in expression marks etc. The only reason why I give it 4 out of 5 stars is due to the smell. It doesn't smell good, but it works wonders!

I love this stuff. I'm so shocked at how well it worked. I can definitely see the lifting and a volumizing in my face it dries down quickly did not leave my skin feeling sticky or dry. I have normal to oily skin if that helps I highly recommend to anyone who is considering try this first.

The packaging of the Exuviance Lift Volumizing Concentrate feels premium and sturdy, The application is very smooth, and the serum glides easily across the skin without any tugging. One of the highlights is its absorption — the formula sinks in quickly and doesn't leave any sticky or heavy residue, which makes it perfect for layering under other skincare or makeup. After consistent use, I noticed great longevity in the results: my skin looks firmer, more lifted, and has a subtle plumping effect that lasts throughout the day. Overall, it's an effective, lightweight concentrate that delivers visible volume and improved skin texture.

This hyaluronic acid face cream for volume is very light and I can't really tell when I'm applying it. I do feel like I've noticed the skin around my cheekbones looking a little plumper. I also feel like the fine lines around my eyes look a little better. I've only been using it for about two weeks and I only use it once a day. It has a slight chemical-like smell to it, but in my opinion you don't really notice it. Great packaging, easy to use,

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I have been using Exuviance Lift Volumizing Cocentrate for about two weeks now. I apply it before my facial cream. It is very lightweight and it does not have the best smell but it seems to help my skin becoming more firm. I have sensitive skin so it has been gentle on my skin. I am very curious of what my skin will feel like and look like in another month or so.

avis.titre: Better Skin Texture in a bottle
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Loved the effect it has on my skin. I could immediately notice an improvement, mainly moisturizing effect. My only disappointment was that it came without the plastic straw to pump out the product. I had to open it and scoop it out. I don't think it's hygienic or that I'll be able to use up all the product this way. I could not place the scent either. It's not pleasant, but also not bad. I prefer it over chemical smell, so I don't mind it. It absorbs pretty quickly and is not oily at all. The texture is like a serum/moisturizer. I still can't figure out the correct amount that I need to scoop out.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have never tried a brand like this before. The consistency every time that it has been used has held up and has never changed. The packaging feels so lux that it makes you want to buy it again. I had no irritation nor did I have any kind of breakout situation while using the product.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] As promised the serum is lightweight, lightly scented and helps with the look of your skin. However, the pump makes it difficult to get the product out which creates a hassle.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] What I like about it: * Good moisturization & plumping: The serum has a strong substance, which attracts and holds moisture in the skin. This helps skin feel dewy, supple, and "plumped" * Lightweight, comfortable texture: Feels light, absorbs quickly, and isn't greasy * Noticeable short-term lift: I felt like my skin showed slightly tighter and appeared more lifted. I did see reduction in the appearance in fine lines. But have to see how this turns out when using it longer than 30 day which I am sure will show more changes with longer use. No reaction was noted. Overall: Exuviance Lift Volumizing Concentrate is a solid hydrating and plumping serum that's particularly worthwhile if your goal is moisture, skin suppleness, and a subtle lift — rather than dramatic anti-aging transformation. Its lightweight feel and layering potential make it easy to integrate into routines

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm not sure if I have noticed any improvement in my skin from using this product. However, it feels nice and doesn't leave my skin feeling oily or dry. I can also feel some tingling so I know it is doing something!

I've been trying the Exuviance Lift Volumizing Concentrate, and I'm honestly impressed with how it feels on the skin. The formula is super hydrating and absorbs quickly without feeling sticky or heavy. After using it consistently, I noticed my skin looking smoother and slightly plumper, especially around my smile lines. The mix of triple hyaluronic acid and NeoGlucosamine really gives the skin a fresh, lifted look. It's not a dramatic "filler" effect, but it definitely helps with volume and firmness over time. If you're looking for something to boost hydration and soften fine lines, this is a great option to add to your routine. Overall, it feels luxurious, works well underneath makeup, and gives visible results with continued use. I definitely recommend it!

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I absolutely love the Exuviance Lift Volumizing Concentrate! It has made my skin feel firmer, smoother, and more hydrated. I've noticed a visible lift and improved texture since I started using it. The serum absorbs quickly and doesn't leave any sticky residue, making it perfect for daily use. Highly recommend for anyone looking to give their skin a healthy, youthful boost!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] So I've been testing this product out for about a month and I do not see any significant difference in my skin, the packaging is convenient, when it goes on it stings a little but that goes away eventually, it does make my skin look moisturized but did nothing to lift my skin

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The Volumizing concentrate is very silky and smooth. The application is simple and leaves my skin feeling refreshed and soft. After a couple of weeks of use I definitely see a positive result.

If you looking and want a gentle, daily-use serum that boosts hydration, improves skin softness, and gives a subtle plumped look, this is a solid pick. This serum has a lightweight texture that quickly absorbs into the skin. Also can be used under makeup.[I received this product in exchange for my honest review]

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The bottle is easy to use. The texture of the product is very good. My skin feels great after using it. It's not sticky on the skin and very smooth. I will buy it again in the future

My initial reaction to this was questionable because the smell really threw me off. It's not a perfume smell, which is good, but I don't know quite how to describe it. I thought it would put me off but it dissipates really fast. I would say that it goes away within 30 seconds. The product itself is amazing. The lotion is very hydrating and is perfect at night and in the day underneath makeup. I've been reaching for it a lot and just hold my breath for a little bit. It seems to absorb well but doesn't leave the skin dry. I love it.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The Evuviance Lift Volumizing Concentrate does wonders for hydrating skin. It absorbs quickly and makes skin feel and look hydrated and plump. This hydrating effect causes subtle lift making skin look and feel more youthful. The dispenser is easy to use and control. It dispenses just the right amount of product ensuring that none goes to waste. It didn't clog my pores or cause breakouts.
